author: RaevNo
boundary_definition: first visible combat frame for each chapter
observations: The reference exits through the main menu after defeated enemies, matching our reset route.
Chapter 1 includes the fixed PLAY tutorial and is our largest remaining gap.
Chapters 2 and 3 are close enough that the new native-menu and dialogue timing changes may erase much of the measured gap.
Our Chapter 4 is already materially faster than the reference.

The reference enters complete words effectively instantaneously; our measured word-input total is already only a few seconds per chapter, so animation resolution and transitions matter more than typing speed.
